Select assay ChEMBL ID from assays, target_type and tax_id from target_dictionary, canonical_smiles from compound_structures, molecule ChEMBL ID and standard_type from activities, and pchembl_value from activities. Join activities to assays on assay_id, assays to target_dictionary on tid, activities to molecule_dictionary on molregno, and molecule_dictionary to compound_structures on molregno. Filter to target CHEMBL1855, target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN', tax_id = 9606, standard_type = 'IC50', standard_relation = '=', and pchembl_value is not null. Keep every qualifying activity row without deduplication. Sort by molecule_chembl_id then assay_chembl_id. Return the first 1000 rows.
